title: Nectarous Peruvian Flour Flatbread
description: A citrusy, chewy flatbread inspired by Peruvian flavors, made with plain flour and a hint of cumin and chili flakes for an adventurous twist.
instructions: In a bowl whisk together plain flour, baking powder, and salt.
Stir in sugar, lemon zest, cumin, and chili flakes until evenly mixed.
Add orange juice, lemon juice, and warm water, then mix until a soft dough forms.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 30 minutes, covered with a damp cloth.
Divide the dough into 6 equal pieces and roll each into a thin oval.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and brush lightly with olive oil.
Cook each flatbread for 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown and chewy, reducing the heat after the first side to maintain even cooking.
Serve warm with a drizzle of honey or a sprinkle of fresh lime zest.
